business_scope.primary_industry_name: Video Game Kernel-Level Anti-Cheat and Integrity Middleware

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic Code; unitary national private law system under Republic of France)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France-China Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (signed 26 Nov 2013; in force 1 Jan 2015)
France-United States Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (1967, as amended by 2009 Protocol)
France-United Kingdom Double Taxation Convention (signed 2009; in force 1 Jan 2010?)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Code de commerce (French Commercial Code): Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (formation, capital, management and operations of a Société à Responsabilité Limitée); Articles L.210-1 et seq. (common incorporation rules); Articles L.123-1 and R.123-1 to R.123-14 (registration with the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) kept by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce in the jurisdiction of the registered office; filings are transmitted through the single electronic window of the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statutory declaration of incorporation (déclaration légale de constitution) submitted via the INPI single window together with the signed articles of association (statuts); no separate central-state duty is levied, but mandatory court-registry fees and chamber-of-commerce taxes are collected electronically at filing, and legal-announcement publication costs are paid to the authorized gazette.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for SARL; the articles may fix any amount, but all cash contributions must be fully paid upon subscription and deposited in a blocked escrow account (compte bloqué) at a French bank or with a notaire, released only upon issuance of the K-bis certificate (Articles L.223-7 and R.223-4 of the Code de commerce).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (i) the founding members, as sole collective decision-making body of the company in formation, ratify the subscription of the entire issued share capital in the amounts and proportions set out in the Articles of Association; (ii) the registered office be fixed at the address stated in the Articles within the jurisdiction of the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés; (iii) [Name] be and is hereby appointed sole gérant with full powers of management, representation, and signature, to open bank accounts and complete all tax, social, and administrative formalities; and (iv) the gérant be authorized to file the incorporation dossier and cure any procedural defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Articles of Association (statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Private deed among all founding shareholders; notarization optional unless a real-estate contribution is made, in which case a French notaire must authenticate the deed.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the statuts in French, including the corporate purpose (objet social: design, development and licensing of kernel-level video-game anti-cheat and integrity middleware), registered office, duration (up to 99 years), share capital, allocations, gérant clauses, transfer restrictions, and dissolution rules. Each page and each original or copy is initialed and signed by every shareholder. Verify that at least one original is kept at the registered office and that shareholders' signatures are ratified for the registry.
required_dossiers: Completed and signed Articles of Association (statuts)
Attestation de domiciliation (landlord consent or commercial domiciliation agreement)
Certified copies of shareholders' identity documents
If a shareholder is a legal entity: K-bis extract and proof of capacity to act
Beneficial-owner declaration data (for the Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry queries the form or the corporate purpose wording, the shareholders adopt a corrective collective decision, execute an amending deed to the statuts, and re-file; the gérant may also request an administrative correction under Article L.123-4 before final registration.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), impots.gouv.fr; customs and indirect duties: Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI), douane.gouv.fr; unified company registration portal: guichet-entreprises.fr (Guichet Unique).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities with a French fixed establishment apply via the Guichet Unique (or historically via CFE), obtaining SIREN/SIRET numbers; VAT identification (numéro de TVA intracommunautaire, format FR + 2-digit key + 9-digit SIREN) is issued by DGFiP. Non-established suppliers of B2C digital/electronic services may register under the OSS Non-Union scheme or through the DGFiP Service des Impôts des Entreprises Étrangères (SIEE) in Paris. A local registered tax representative may be required for certain foreign suppliers.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box. SARL may elect income-tax treatment (IR) under art. 239 bis AA CGI for a 5-year period; VAT grouping election (assujetti unique) under art. 256 C CGI; fiscal integration (intégration fiscale) under art. 223 A CGI; parent-subsidiary regime (régime mère-fille) under art. 145 CGI; hybrid mismatch rules under ATAD as transposed in art. 212 bis CGI.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée - TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No VAT registration threshold for established businesses; any taxable economic activity triggers registration. Domestic small-business exemption (franchise en base de TVA) applies only below approximately EUR 93,600 annual turnover for goods and EUR 37,500 for services (2024 thresholds, with lower limits EUR 85,000 and EUR 34,100); exceeding these triggers mandatory registration. Non-established foreign suppliers of B2C electronic/digital services must register from the first euro (no threshold) under OSS Non-Union, or under the direct SIEE registration route.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory B2B e-invoicing phased from 1 September 2026 (large and mid-size taxpayers) and 1 September 2027 (SMEs/micro), using certified Plateforme de Dématérialisation Partenaire (PDP) or the public portal in a Y-shaped double-flow transmission model; structured e-reporting of B2C transactions and cross-border supplies is transmitted to DGFiP; formats include Factur-X/UBL with PEPPOL/API-based interoperability; Chorus Pro remains the portal for public procurement. France does not apply per-invoice real-time fiscal clearance stamping; periodic VAT returns (CA3) and Intrastat/DEB (EC Sales List) filings apply.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods to destinations outside the EU are zero-rated under art. 262-I CGI; intra-EU dispatches to a VAT-registered customer are exempt under art. 262-ter CGI. B2B services (including gaming anti-cheat middleware/SaaS and integrity monitoring) are outside French VAT under the place-of-supply rule of art. 259-1 CGI where the customer is established outside France; B2C supplies of electronic services to EU consumers are declared via OSS at destination-state rates. Zero-rating requires proof of physical exportation (movement outside the EU within one year), supported by transport and commercial documentation, and arm's-length pricing.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAE via DELTA/ECS electronic system)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / CMR or equivalent transport document
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank settlement evidence (FX repatriation proof)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: False or erroneous zero-rating claims trigger a 40% penalty for bad faith and 80% for fraudulent manoeuvres (art. 1729-1 CGI), plus late-payment interest (intérêt de retard) of 0.20% per month. Retrospective reassessment is generally limited to 3 years (art. L. 169 LPF), extended to 6 years for active concealment and 10 years for unfiled returns. Criminal sanctions for VAT fraud (art. 1741 CGI) include fines up to EUR 500,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years; DGFiP and DGDDI jointly enforce export documentary compliance, with clawback of input VAT and reversal of output VAT exemption upon documentary failure.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (French central banking authority) under the framework of the Eurosystem and the French Prudential Supervision and Resolution Authority (ACPR), with cross-border capital account administration coordinated by the Direction Générale du Trésor.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France is a member of the euro area; the euro is fully convertible on both current and capital account transactions under the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union and the French Code Monétaire et Financier. Current account convertibility is unrestricted, including trade payments, service fees, and profit remittances. Capital account convertibility is equally free under the EU capital movement directive, with residual administrative reporting requirements for balance-of-payments purposes. Profit remittance by an SARL is permitted through shareholder distributions, provided corporate tax returns are filed, financial statements are audited when applicable, and any required withholding tax certificate is obtained under the applicable tax treaty. No pre-approval is required for converting EUR to foreign currency; however, banks may apply tightened compliance screening for certain foreign counterparties or sanctioned jurisdictions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory requirement in France to forcibly surrender export proceeds or to convert foreign currency export receipts into euro within a prescribed timeline. Export proceeds may be retained in foreign currency accounts at a licensed credit institution. Nonetheless, French residents must file monthly balance-of-payments reporting with Banque de France when aggregated cross-border transactions exceed EUR 50,000 per calendar month, and they must be able to evidence the underlying trade transaction. Mandatory conversion ratios are not applied by the French authorities.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating for an EU-passported or French-licensed Electronic Money Institution (EMI) is Medium. A digital EMI such as a licensed fintech e-money institution may be used for receivables collection and payouts, but it is not a substitute for a full credit institution when the SARL needs SWIFT-based correspondent clearing, commercial letters of credit, or a committed FX line. Legal constraints include authorisation requirements under ACPR, safeguarding requirements on client funds, and the limitation that EMIs cannot extend credit. The cross-border EMIs established outside France may operate under EU passporting, but they must comply with French e-money regulations and cannot act as the primary treasury bank for all liquidity clearing, especially for capital injections from non-EU shareholders.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French banks generally require at least one beneficial owner, director, or authorised representative with authority over the account to be physically present for the initial KYC interview at the branch or notary/Hub of the bank. Remote opening is possible for certain EU/EEA shareholders or established corporate entities with a French registered office, but the final validation often includes a videoconference interview followed by notarisation of signatures. For non-EU directors or majority non-resident ownership, physical presence is typically mandated for sanction screening, source-of-funds validation, and signature verification. A French SARL with a local registered office and a local registered agent materially improves the chance of remote onboarding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction or sanctioned individual/entity appearing in the UBO chain or counterparty screening
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Entity charts with full UBO hierarchy, passports, proof of address, a detailed tariff code and invoice registry, bank references from the parent company, negative media and sanction screening reports, and an external compliance opinion confirming no exposure to sanctioned goods or entities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership ambiguity or non-resident shareholder with layered ownership
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised corporate registry certificates (extrait K-bis), registers of beneficial owners deposited with the French Commercial Court, signed sworn statements of UBO nature, share register, and capital contribution transfer receipts linking the bank receipt to the capital injection payment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds and wealth origin mismatch regarding initial capital escrow
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited shareholder financial statements, bank statements of the funding entity, tax residency certificates, salary slips or investment liquidation evidences, and a board resolution authorising the parent financing of the French SARL.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Potential gaming-chargeback or anti-cheat software liability creating reputational risk
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Product liability insurance, localised software licensing contracts, regulatory compliance attestation for the video game industry, well-defined end-user licence agreements, and a customer support and refund policy that meets French consumer protection standards.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained cross-border flows from overseas gaming partners
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial contracts, quarterly royalty statements, customer due diligence files on gaming publishers, payment purpose codes, and a transfer pricing certificate confirming arm's length consideration for middleware licences.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The parent company or non-resident shareholder injects equity contributions via SWIFT MT103 with the creditor beneficiary being the SARL's French bank account and the debtor institution confirmed by a financial institution registry. The wire must reference the purpose code 'Capital Injection / Share Capital Contribution' with the exact wording 'Apport en compte courant d'associé' for shareholder loans or 'Augmentation de capital' for registered equity. Banque de France balance-of-payments reporting must be triggered if the monthly cross-border threshold of EUR 50,000 is exceeded. The bank will require the corporate resolution, the updated statuts, the notarised declaration of subscription and payment, and the French cashier certificate from the bank confirming funds deposit. A compliant injection should use the French account of the SARL only and should never mix trade receivables with capital in the same wire.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements for gaming anti-cheat licensing fees, middleware revenue share, and advance payments to foreign technology partners are executed through the standard SWIFT MT103 for occasional cross-border corporate payments and through MT202 COV for interbank and subsidiary funding flows. For high-value procurement or recurring service agreements, French banks provide commercial standby letters of credit and documentary collection platforms; however, the licensing-royalty model usually relies on clean payments, invoice matching, and transfer pricing documentation. SEPA credit transfer is the mandatory rail for domestic euro disbursements within France and the EEA, while SWIFT EUR transfers are used only when the receiving account is outside the SEPA zone or when MT103 format is required by the beneficiary bank. All outbound payments must carry a valid purpose code, the underlying contract reference, and a copy of the invoice or royalty statement, and they must be reflected in the SARL's balance-of-payments reporting if applicable.
permissible_fx_hedging_instructions: Cross-currency swaps with a licensed French credit institution
Non-deliverable forwards where the counterparty is a regulated EU bank and the SARL demonstrates a genuine commercial hedging need

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of annual financial statements (Comptes annuels) to the RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the competent French Commercial Court
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Ordinary general meeting must approve the accounts within 6 months of the fiscal year-end; filing with RCS must occur within 1 month after approval. Calendar-year SARL: approve by 30 June, file by 31 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Public Prosecutor may summon the legal representative before the Commercial Court; civil fine up to €2,500; possible judicial injunctions with periodic penalty (astreinte); repeated non-compliance may result in removal (radiation) from the RCS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Déclaration de résultats No. 2065 plus supplementary schedules No. 2058 and annexes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year fiscal years: file by 3 May of the following year (online deadline extended to 5 May); for non-calendar fiscal years: within 3 months of the closing date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalties: 10% of tax due if filed within 30 days, 40% after 30 days, and 80% if never filed; late-payment interest accrues at 0.20% per month. Balance of corporate income tax is payable by 15 May.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Local business tax (Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises, CFE) annual payment and mandatory establishment declaration for any new operating site
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP (service local des impôts des entreprises)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Existing company: CFE is assessed on prior-year business criteria and must be paid by 15 December of the tax year. New establishment: the Form No. 1447-C declaration must be filed by 31 December of the year following creation.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment penalties: 5% surcharge if paid within 30 days, 10% thereafter; monthly late-payment interest of 0.20%; coercive recovery via distraint may follow.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory appointment of a statutory auditor (Commissaire aux Comptes) is triggered if the SARL exceeds at least two of three thresholds at fiscal year-end: balance-sheet total > €4,000,000; net revenue > €8,000,000; average headcount > 50. Shareholders owning at least one-third of the capital may also petition the court to appoint an auditor.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (ANC règlement No. 2014-03, Plan Comptable Général) is mandatory for the SARL's individual statutory financial statements; IFRS applies only to consolidated accounts of listed groups and is not applicable to this entity.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France does not impose a standalone annual UBO re-declaration. The RCS annual-accounts filing requires the legal representative to certify that the RCS and beneficial-owner register (Déclaration des Bénéficiaires Effectifs) remain accurate; any change in ownership or beneficial control must be filed within 30 days. Share transfers in a SARL are recorded in the register of members and become opposable to third parties only after registration with the RCS and, where applicable, publication in a legal gazette.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Managers / Directors (Registre des gérants)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 25% statutory rate with R&D tax credit (up to 30% of qualifying R&D expenses), innovation status benefits, and potential tax exemptions for qualifying investments

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulaire 2065 - Déclaration de résultat, filed electronically via impots.gouv.fr or e-impots.gouv.fr
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 3 months after the end of the fiscal year (generally 31 March for calendar year companies)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net turnover for the fiscal year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report French and foreign turnover; TP adjustments required for related-party transactions

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Profit before corporate income tax, including all adjustments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A for French residents; non-residents file via form 2047

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions for operating expenses, interest, and TP-compliant costs
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Allowable only if arm's length; non-residents claim via treaty relief

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits including R&D and innovation incentives
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Available to French residents; non-residents may claim under applicable treaties

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable base after all adjustments and deductions

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalties: 0.5% of unpaid tax per month of delay (maximum 25%); minimum €200 administrative fine; possible criminal prosecution for intentional non-compliance

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit Form 5001 (Titre de Résidence Certificatif) to the tax authorities with supporting documents to claim reduced treaty rates on dividends
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 5% statutory rate (reduced to 0-10% under most treaties); Interest: 12.8% statutory rate (reduced to 0-10% under most treaties)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: 50 million euros (local file threshold; 750 million euros for master file)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable to holding or IP entities; operating gaming anti-cheat engine requires substantial French economic activity, employees, and decision-making to avoid recharacterization

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of taxable income or false declarations to reduce tax liability
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalty up to 5 years imprisonment and fines up to 500% of evaded tax; civil restitution of unpaid taxes plus interest
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal criminal liability including imprisonment and civil restitution for fraudulent conduct

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Establishing a French SARL without real business operations, employees, or decision-making in France
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterization as non-resident entity; penalties up to 500% of tax due plus criminal sanctions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil; directors personally liable for tax debts and potential imprisonment

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain TP documentation or using non-arm's length pricing without justification
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties of 500% of additional tax due; possible restitution of tax benefits and interest
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability for tax shortfalls if gross negligence or willful misconduct

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to report cross-border transactions or beneficial owners to tax authorities
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to 500,000 euros or higher; possible criminal prosecution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for fines and potential jail time for serious breaches

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to File or Late Filing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Not filing the corporate tax return by the deadline
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines of 0.5% per month of delay on the tax due (capped at 25%); possible criminal referral
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may face personal liability in cases of gross negligence
